changes.title: Party over
items: When the last soundsystem falls, the party's over: no game-over screen, an afterparty. The waves stop, nothing fights, and every animal strolls home and falls asleep, even the ones that ran off. Wander the sleeping forest as long as you like

changes.title: Afterparty sound
items: When the party's over the music winds down like a record stopping, and each area has its own quiet night: wind in the pines, frogs in the bogs, owls and crickets in the woods, the sea at home
Sleeping animals snore softly near you

changes.title: Stars
items: The stars show again through the soft blur at the top of the screen; how much the sky blurs is a slider in the decisions panel
The moon reads clearly through the blur at every phase, and a thin crescent is one unbroken sliver

changes.title: Stall log
items: The debug overlay (~) notes every freeze of a tenth of a second or more and what it was busy with, and the playtest log (L) keeps them

changes.title: Spiral route
items: The ley line now spirals out from home: the party spreads steadily outward, ring by ring, round every side of home in turn, with now and then a little lobe and a few crossings (?route=varied for the old route)

changes.title: Soft reveal
items: Walking through thick forest, the treetops around the witch fade away softly, tree by tree, instead of in rings

changes.title: Smooth legs
items: Creatures' legs read as smooth limbs, not strings of balls: a full thigh tapering to the knee, and hind legs that bend back at the hock

changes.title: Relic placement
items: Every map now has one of each of the six relics: one waiting near the edge of home, the rest scattered across the forest, never close together
Each relic has its golden sigil lying on the ground just in front of it: stand on it and press E to pick the relic up

changes.title: Rebuild slices
items: Smoother flying over the forest: the scenery around you is rebuilt a little each frame instead of all at once

changes.title: Rebuild fps
items: On a slow machine the scenery is rebuilt in one go again, so trees no longer pop in when the frame rate is low

changes.title: Quests while sleeping
items: A sleeping legend's quest no longer closes when its area's soundsystem switches on: bring it the creature it dreams of any time it's asleep, and its buff is yours

changes.title: No road decor
items: Broken bits of road and tarmac no longer turn up scattered in the forest as clutter; the real roads and paths are unchanged

changes.title: No guards
items: Behind the scenes: the old guards (a quest-done area's creatures defending it) are gone from the code; nothing changes in play

changes.title: Moon r3
items: The night wood is blue-green again, not lavender: the moonlight on the treetops and open ground is paler
Dark crowns and rock spires no longer show a grid of bright dots in the moonlight; faded tree trunks fade in soft clusters
In the bold and ref art styles the witch now stands out in her own light
A partied area's ground glows warm amber again; its neon colour stays on the bulbs and the soundsystem

changes.title: Leylines variety
items: Ley line routes vary from map to map (Ed: "mix in back-and-forth sweeps and lobes so maps aren't all spirals"): petals round home, then sweeps, lobes or combs, still with no crossings (at most four allowed, 12 waves apart, none in the first 12).

changes.title: Leylines uncrossed
items: The ley line now runs through every wave's runestone the whole time, brightest from the last one reached, and never crosses itself (Ed: "I thought the idea was to have no crossings?"): the waves follow the noisy picker's order, untangled, so every map's route still differs. ?picker=noisy for the old order.

changes.title: Ley pulse
items: A pulse of light travels along the ley line toward the next soundsystem, the line glowing brighter as the next wave nears, and arrives just as the wave does
While home's speakers boot up there's no ley line; when the first wave's countdown starts, the line grows out from the treehouse, reaching the third runestone as the wave lands

changes.title: Legends in half
items: Legends now sleep in only about half the areas, spread across the map; the rest have no legend, clearing or quest

changes.title: Legend sleep
items: Legends look for their own kind every 5 seconds, each on its own beat; an angry legend calms back to sleep once one of its kind is back in its area; and a legend going back to sleep away from where it lay walks home first and lies down where it spawned (Ed).

changes.title: Legend back trees
items: The bear, elk and beaver legends grow real little trees on their backs: oaks, pines and willows, bigger and lit for the night

changes.title: Invites linger
items: 💌s now spin flat like a frisbee as they fly
💌s that miss now lie flat on the ground for a couple of seconds before they fade away

changes.title: Horizon lead
items: Creatures far ahead over the treetops no longer pop into view at the horizon

changes.title: Ground copy
items: Fewer hitches flying over new ground: each new patch of ground is copied straight in, instead of through the graphics card's framebuffers

changes.title: Grass cell
items: Far from the middle of the map, the grass and ferns round her grow where she stands again (they were fetched up to 18 m off)

changes.title: Dash to cursor
items: Your dodge now goes towards the mouse cursor (a little diamond shows where you'd land); with the cursor right on the witch, it goes the way she's facing

changes.title: Controls space wheel
items: Controls: Space rises and lands, E puts a sigil down, Q cycles your sigils (on the ground too), and the mouse wheel zooms

changes.title: Circle from stone
items: A sleeping legend's circle now lies well away from its area's runestone, never beside the soundsystem's party

changes.title: Charges
items: Charging animals (boars, elk, stags, rams, hedgehogs, woodlice) now run much further, carrying their momentum past you in wide arcs before they come round again
A charging animal hurts anyone it touches on its way, not only at the end; a lynx's pounce carries on through you
Fights with chargers and lynxes are much more dangerous: keep moving and blink across their lane
A wild animal knocked down in a fight now lies stunned for 20 seconds before it runs off, plenty of time to win it over with 💌s
Wild animals now chase you up to 30 m outside their area, then give up and trot back home instead of waiting at the edge

changes.title: Boot ring
items: The game now starts when you cast the party spell: a ley line runs round the dancefloor's ring of runestones, clockwise from the top, and its pulse turns each stone into a speaker; when the last one turns, the first wave's countdown begins
